picks.title: Google lets you make personal Android apps for free now – with just prompts
picks.excerpt: It just got a whole lot easier to vibe code the exact Android app you need - no developer experience required.
picks.rationale: Google AI Studio now builds and installs personal Android apps from prompts for free. A designer could prototype a working phone app tomorrow with no developer.

picks.title: Android will use Gemini to warn you about scammy messages
picks.excerpt: Google will tell if you a scammer is trying to message you and will protect your banking details from prying eyes while sharing your screen.
picks.rationale: New Android security features: on-device Gemini flags scam messages and hides banking details during screen sharing. This is a newly announced feature, not a rehash.

picks.title: Apple Intelligence Coming to China in December With iOS 27.3
picks.excerpt: Apple plans to bring Apple Intelligence to China in iOS 27.3 after two years of regulatory delays, reports Bloomberg. The launch will include basic Apple Intelligence features for things like photo editing, but Siri AI won't be available. Image Playground and the newer version of Genmoji will be mis
picks.rationale: After two years of regulatory delay, Apple Intelligence gets a China launch date (iOS 27.3, December). Siri AI, Image Playground and the new Genmoji are left out.

picks.title: Apple researchers turn idle Macs into a virtual GPU cloud with ‘Minions’
picks.excerpt: Can start with a simple request over Slack, but teams worry about their data running on devices outside their group.
picks.rationale: Apple researchers pool idle Macs into a shared GPU cloud that is requested over Slack. It is a new way to get local AI compute from hardware people already own.

picks.title: HMD brings AI companionship to a basic flip phone, complete with a recurring subscription
picks.excerpt: HMD has introduced a new version of its 2660 Flip with an AI companion designed to combat loneliness among elderly users. The AI can remember previous conversations, tell stories, and even play games, but continued companionship comes with a monthly subscription fee after a five-hour free trial.
picks.rationale: HMD launches a feature-phone version with a memory-keeping AI companion for elderly users, sold on a subscription after a five-hour trial. It is a new device and a new business model for AI hardware.

alternates.title: Gemini for Home is finally learning that ‘stop’ means stop
alternates.rationale: This is the October Gemini for Home update, a new release that is separate from the 10-02 September update card. It would be a third Google card, so it is an alternate.

alternates.title: Nothing’s first smart glasses leak reveals two very different bets
alternates.excerpt: One pair reportedly skips the camera, while the other could add ChatGPT.
alternates.rationale: This is a leak, not a launch, so it ranks lower on credibility and novelty. It is an alternate.

alternates.title: My Friend Has No Soul
alternates.excerpt: The second iteration of the viral Friend AI necklace is louder and less interesting.
alternates.rationale: A review of the second Friend AI pendant. It overlaps the HMD AI-companion pick, so it is an alternate.
